The cache backend service has been rewritten from the ground up for improved performance and reliability. actions/cache now integrates with the new cache service (v2) APIs.

The new service will gradually roll out as of February 1st, 2025. The legacy service will also be sunset on the same date. Changes in these release are fully backward compatible.

We are deprecating some versions of this action. We recommend upgrading to version v4 or v3 as soon as possible before February 1st, 2025. (Upgrade instructions below).

If you are using pinned SHAs, please use the SHAs of versions v4.2.0 or v3.4.0

If you do not upgrade, all workflow runs using any of the deprecated actions/cache will fail.

Upgrading to the recommended versions will not break your workflows.

issue.title: Hisense E50 lite
issue.body:
I checked and the E50 lite uses the sc9863a soc and my phone has a network look and the contract has been fulfilled but the carrier won't respond to my emails.
and i want to know if i can use this exploit or not ?
and if i can what should i do since there is no E50 specific folder.
thanks in advance.

comment.body:
Believe me when i say if i could i would.
but i solved it by downloading a non network locked rom form needrom.com and puting the phone in download mode with adb reboot autodloader 
then flashing the .pac file with spd flashtool

qpwgraph: update to 0.8.1

Co-authored-by: Kaiyang Wu (@OriginCode) <self@origincode.me>

libxnvctrl: update to 565.57.01

Signed-off-by: Kaiyang Wu <origincode@aosc.io>

systemd: fix credential setup issue with QEMU user emulation

Systemd tries to fork() with CLONE_NEWNS, which is not supported by QEMU
user emulation, to set up credentials. Previously few systemd units use
ImportCredential=, so the container can still boot with QEMU user
emulation. Now almost all units use it, rendering the container
unbootable.

This fix tries to fork() again without CLONE_NEWNS if the returned value
is -EINVAL, similar as [1].

[1]: https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/28954

go-md2man: update to 2.0.5

Co-authored-by: 白铭骢 (Mingcong Bai) (@MingcongBai) <jeffbai@aosc.io>
